description:
The integration catalog: the systems a Typestate backend works with,
made and checked by Typestate. A built-in one is turned on with one
setting tool, which the answer names. A declared one was called
against the real vendor on the date the answer gives, and
apply_integration copies it into a service. Ask before you write a
declaration yourself with define_integration.

need.description: What the backend needs, or a vendor's name: "payments", "send email", "Slack". Leave it out to list the whole catalog.

name: list_integration_catalog

answer.description: The matching integrations, one paragraph each.

title: List the Typestate integration catalog
